headline: Nearly Half of Businesses in Puebla Operate Informally, COE Estimates
summary: The COE business council in Puebla estimates nearly half of local businesses operate informally. Some renting premises have staff without statutory benefits, its president said.
why: Informal business activity reduces tax revenue and limits workers' social protection, affecting the size and stability of the formal economy. Investors track it as a measure of economic structure in Mexican states.
original_headline: Casi la mitad de los negocios en Puebla operan en la informalidad, estima el COE
